project.name: Marbella Boat Charter × Archic
project.sector: Yacht, sailing, fishing and group charter across the Costa del Sol; base in Puerto Banús

direction.justification: The business is geographically and operationally broad: a Puerto Banús base serving several Costa del Sol ports, nearly thirty published vessels across four operation types, longer Strait routes, events, catering and yacht management. The interface therefore behaves like a coastal navigation office: chart, register, route atlas, technical plate and charter desk. Archic Foundation remains underneath as a QA contract, while the client-facing component grammar is deliberately unique to this business rather than reusing the Index/hero/card patterns of prior projects.
direction.archetypeRepeatJustification: Dossier is expressed through marine operating documents and technical plates, not through a previously shipped visual component set. No client-facing component is intentionally copied from another Archic project.
